gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.

Complete-source native PM fixture uses actual work cancellation and GPIO emulation; no electrical I2C/RDY, sensor wake reseed, shared-bus timing or physical PM acceptance.

timeout_conversion: Full uint16 verification intervals, exact ceiling and tick ABI. Host checks cover all 65536 waits at 14 rates, both tick widths, optimized/sanitized/coverage/m32 variants and identified math/width controls. The complete-source native fixture compares the actual Zephyr conversion at 7 rates while preserving all 3 PM contexts and 3 repeats of the same binary. Physical timing remains unmeasured.
